description: A Perl script that performs static analysis and linting on shell script files, specifically targeting test definitions and common shell script problems such as broken &&-chains and unclosed heredocs. It includes a lexical analyzer and parser for POSIX shell syntax, as well as logic for detecting issues in test scripts.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: A lexical analyzer for POSIX shell scripts, capable of tokenizing shell syntax including here-docs, strings, operators, and comments.

classes.name: ShellParser
classes.description: A recursive descent parser for POSIX shell scripts, supporting command, control structures, and compound commands.

classes.name: TestParser
classes.description: A subclass of ShellParser that analyzes test command structures within shell scripts to detect common problems such as missing '&&' or '|| return 1'.

classes.name: ScriptParser
classes.description: A subclass of ShellParser that identifies individual test definitions within scripts and passes test bodies to TestParser for problem detection.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for Lexer, ShellParser, TestParser, and ScriptParser classes.

methods.name: scan_token
methods.description: Tokenizes the next shell script token in Lexer.

methods.name: parse_cmd
methods.description: Parses a shell command in ShellParser and its subclasses.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: High-level parse method that processes tokens until a stop condition.

methods.name: check_test
methods.description: Analyzes a test command for problems and reports issues.

methods.name: format_problem
methods.description: Formats detected problem types into human-readable messages.
